steps: Log in to the banking application or website using valid credentials.
Navigate to the 'Transfer Funds' or 'Send Money' section.
Select the source account from which the funds will be debited (if not pre-selected).
Enter the recipient's name or account details (in this case, 'ann').
Input the transfer amount as '10' in the amount field.
Confirm the currency is set to 'USD'.
Review all details for accuracy, including recipient, amount, and currency.
Confirm and submit the transfer request, then verify the confirmation message.
